what: Live predict + plan checks, one fixture per D660 family, through an OpenAI-compatible LiteLLM gateway to Gemini; production engine and verifier defaults, verifier-v2, local corpus search, plan bar 0.92. Development checks on fixtures built from pool rulings, one run each, not an evaluation. Duty rates and costs are illustrative.

runs.best_plan: Move the parent rolls to China
runs.hand_note: N340077 (tissue, napkins and towels converted from Indonesian parent rolls, held Indonesia) supports it: the parent roll decides.

runs.best_plan: Move the chassis and frame and the working frames to South Korea
runs.hand_note: N334276 (scissor lifts: two of three structural subassemblies made in Poland, held Poland) supports moving both frames, by analogy. Backtest: in N337718 CBP held South Korea with a Korean handling frame and roll tray in the upper frame; the plan's single working-frame move was supported at 0.90, below the 0.92 bar, so the shown plan moves more than CBP's case did.

runs.best_plan: Move the bare wafers and the front-end wafer fabrication to China
runs.hand_note: N333677 (a silicon pressure sensor whose die is made in the United States, held United States) supports front-end fabrication deciding origin; it is a sensor, not an integrated circuit: partial.

runs.best_plan: Move the club heads to China
runs.hand_note: N340536 (putter heads formed in Vietnam and finished in China, held Vietnam) supports it: the forming country decides.

No plan shown. Backtest: CBP held Vietnam in scenario 2 of N343777, where the cutting and sewing move to Vietnam; the plan found that move (engine Vietnam) but the check gave 0.90, below the 0.92 bar, citing N342448 (a Part 102 textile ruling).

runs.best_plan: Move the burners and the oxygen depletion sensor assemblies and ignitor module to Vietnam
runs.hand_note: N346005 (vent-free gas logs and a stove with a Chinese burner and log set, assembled in Vietnam, held China) supports the burner and sensor assemblies deciding origin.
